visualReview.notes: Inspected54 final current frames:12 portable,12 shared-material/flat-map and30 Earth-rig/native-field/tier views. Complete original New York Plaza Hotel follows the exact stepped Q1066676 whole footprint,with the short main entrance facade signed+X/ESE toward Fifth Avenue/Grand Army Plaza and the long park-facing facade-Z/NNE toward Central Park South. Pale masonry,punched windows,rusticated lower bands,projecting cornices/sills and upper balconies support the distinct green mansard,two dormer rows,inset skylight strips,paired gables,rounded eastern corner bays and ribbed dark domed caps. The complete shallow rooftop and plant remain above the body rather than an invented ground-level courtyard. Primary canopy,recessed enclosed vestibule,secondary north canopy and reconstructed native-fitting stairs complete the exterior. Visual iteration closed the inner mansard faces,joined the roof corners and stepped western seam,removed decorative bands crossing the entry opening,closed its ceiling and raised the initial overly deep roofwell to the photographed shallow rooftop. Four focused tests prove exact source reconstruction,signed placement,native stair contact,complete gables/turrets/mansard/western roof joints/inner return/shallow roofwell,eastern canopy,physical near vestibule recess and ceiling,and exact tier budgets/separate GPU streams/shared graphs. Production viewer removes all11 actual native hotel parent/part polygons while preserving four actual neighboring buildings,including the western church-side neighbors. Five existing256px limestone,slate,painted metal,window grid and granite graphs add no private or embedded images. Stone and trim share one limestone graph;the green slate/patina is a catalog approximation. Patterned glass is opaque and excludes optical interiors. Source master remains separate from four browser tiers. Skyline/district aggregate openings,facade and roof ornaments. Retained76m total and generalized85m map height disagree;55.5m cornice,72.5m mansard and75.9m finials are photographic proportions guided by76m,not a certified as-built schedule. Facade/gable/dormer/floor inventories,western/southern sections,plant and entry/canopy details remain original approximations. Adjacent church,interiors,furnishings,flags,street furniture and surrounding city are excluded. Unmodified129x129/1.5m field oversamples two ordinary global DEM tiles;16m base is rounded from its center and native perimeter returns are roughly15–16m. Foundation skirts embed into it and stair ends meet it approximately. Original curb,foundation,accessible-entry gradients and absolute roof datum are unsurveyed. Portable fallback and shared viewer surfaces differ. Generic synthetic close cameras can crop parts of the facade;custom whole-hotel/detail and explicit four-tier views establish coverage. Minor shadow/facet/LOD differences and physical-device/dense-city timing remain unmeasured.
